context: A police officer interviews a manager about an industry fraud case
purpose: Teach: 返答/内訳/値上がり/倍増/消耗/受給/心得/規律

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 業界全体で、値上がりに乗じた詐欺が倍増しています。
lines.en: Fraud exploiting price hikes has doubled across the entire industry.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Opens on factual weight without alarm. Steady eye contact. Professional but not cold — this is information that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、社内でも問い合わせが消耗する量です。
lines.en: Yes — the volume of inquiries we're fielding has been exhausting.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment with a undertone of strain. Small pause before the qualification. Not complaining, just naming what's true. Tired but focused.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害の内訳、業種別に整理されていますか。
lines.en: Have you sorted the damage breakdown by industry?
lines.style: Precise, methodical. Each phrase lands cleanly. Slight forward lean — not aggressive, but clarifying. The rhythm of someone who knows what information he needs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。受給契約に関する詐欺も含まれます。
lines.en: Yes. That includes fraud tied to benefit-payout contracts.
lines.style: Direct update, no filler. Steady pace. Shows he's been listening and prepared. Small nod of understanding on the offer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 規律ある返答を、被害者に届けたいですね。
lines.en: We want to deliver clear, disciplined answers to the victims.
lines.style: Gentle but unwavering. Shifts slightly — this is about the people, not just the procedure. Quiet insistence on care alongside protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察の心得、勉強になります。
lines.en: Your approach to this — really helps me understand what matters.
lines.style: Warm genuineness. Slow enough to be sincere. No false modesty, but real recognition. Closes with quiet respect.
